name: The Rock's DDT
description: This move may only be played by The Rock. Counters mad rush moves. If you have any Knowledge you draw a page and gain 1 Attitude. If you have any Agility you draw a page and gain 1 Attitude. Counts as DDT.

name: Rock Bottom
description: Only The Rock may play Rock Bottom. Counters arm extended and in close moves. If your opponent is not stunned and has less pages in hand you do, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

name: Arm Drag Takedown
description: Counters mad rush moves. If you have any Knowledge Momentum, draw one page.

name: European Uppercut
description: Play only as a counter or if you have Strike. Counters in close moves.

name: Armbar
description: Counters back to foe moves, is countered by Armbar. Your opponent takes 2 Arm damage each turn. Every turn there is a 40% chance that this hold is released.

name: Double Leg Takedown
description: Counters leg extended and victim below moves.

name: Forearm Smash
description: This move does up to +2 damage. (Face page: cannot be played if you have played a Heel page.)

name: Headlock
description: Counters behind opponent and in close moves. When this move connects, if your opponent has any Head damage, draw a page. Your opponent cannot submit to this move.

name: Shoulder Block
description: Counters leg extended moves. Countered by Shoulder Block.

name: Slap
description: Your opponent ditches a random page from hand that isn't Momentum, and gains 3 Attitude.

name: Snap Mare
description: Counters behind opponent moves.

name: Body Slam
description: Counters mad rush and high risk moves.

name: Ear Clap
description: This move does 1 Head damage.

name: Elbow
description: Counters back to foe and behind opponent moves.

name: Elbow To The Kidneys
description: Counters back to foe moves. This move does 3 back damage.

name: Elbow to Back of the Head
description: Counters head down moves. Your opponent takes 2 head damage. 50% chance opponent loses +1 Attitude.

name: Fireman's Carry
description: Counters leg extended and victim below moves. 50% chance your opponent both ditches the next playbook page and loses 1 additional Momentum.

name: Hammerlock
description: Counters back to foe moves. Countered by Hammerlock. Your opponent takes 1 Arm damage each turn. During the Refresh step, 50% chance you draw a page.

name: Headbutt
description: Big Superstars Trademark

name: Punch
description: Counters arm extended and in close moves.

name: Wristlock
description: This move does 2 arm damage per turn, but can't cause submissions. At the end of the turn if there are any Specials in your opponent's hand, one is ditched (randomly chosen) and your opponent draws a page.

name: Armbar Takedown
description: Counters arm extended moves. Your opponent takes 1 Arm damage and there is a 50% chance your opponent's next page is ditched.

name: Atomic Drop
description: Counters back to foe moves. 50% chance your opponent loses an additional Momentum.

name: Back Body Drop
description: Counters mad rush and victim below moves. Countered by Facebuster.

name: Clothesline
description: Counters hit or miss and leg extended moves. Countered by Clothesline and Duck. Your opponent is put on the mat.

name: Eye Rake
description: This move counters arm extended, in close, standing above and behind opponent moves. You receive 2 Warnings and your opponent loses +1 Attitude.

name: Hip Toss
description: Counters mad rush moves. Countered by Hip Toss. Your opponent's next 2 pages from playbook are ditched.

name: Inside Cradle
description: Counters in close and standing above moves. Your opponent is put on the mat and you Pin your opponent. If the pin does not work you stay in Control. (After a failed pin attempt, your opponent is removed from the mat.)

name: Knee Lift
description: Counters in close and head down moves.

name: Pump Handle
description: Counters behind opponent moves. Your opponent takes 1 Arm damage and has his next 2 pages from playbook ditched.

name: Standing Side Headlock
description: Your opponent takes 1 Head damage per turn, but can't submit to this move. When this move connects, you draw a random Hold from your playbook.

name: Back Elbow
description: Counters behind opponent moves.

name: Back Heel Trip
description: Counters leg extended moves. If your opponent doesn't have any Technical, this move can't be countered by a move.

name: Back Suplex
description: Counters back to foe moves. This move does 1 Back damage.

name: Chop
description: Countered by Chop. If used to counter Chop, you take 4 damage and if your opponent's playbook has a Chop, your opponent draws it.

name: Flip Clothesline
description: This move may only be played by X-Pac. This move does up to +5 damage.

name: Front Heel Trip
description: Original Technical page.

name: Inverted Atomic Drop
description: Counters in close moves. Technical Combo: +4 damage. (If you connected with a Technical move last turn, this move does +4 damage.)

name: Kendo Stick Shot
description: Play only in a Hardcore match. This move does +1 damage for each time either player has connected with Kendo Stick Shot. Kendo Stick is put into play (unless there is already one in play).

name: Running Elbow
description: Spike Dudley Trademark Play only in the ring. If your opponent is a Cruiserweight, they are put on the mat and you draw a page. Otherwise, you get +2 Attitude.

name: Turnbuckle Smash
description: Play only in the ring. Countered by Turnbuckle Smash. For each point of Strike momentum you have you do an additional 2 damage (up to +10.)

name: Abdominal Stretch
description: Countered by Hip Toss. This move does 6 Back damage per turn. At the end of the turn there is a 25% chance that this hold is released. (Your opponent gets control.)

name: Back Body Drop to Ringside
description: Play this move only in the ring. Counters victim below moves. Your opponent is moved to Ringside. There is a 33% chance your opponent ditches his next page from his playbook.

name: Big Back Body Drop
description: Counters mad rush moves. Technical Combo: Get +1 Attitude. (Counts as "Back Body Drop".)

name: Chair Shot
description: Play this move only if Steel Folding Chair is in play. You get 4 Warnings from the referee. Your opponent takes 5 Head damage and is Stunned until the end of the next turn.

name: Chair To The Back
description: Play only if Steel Folding Chair is in play. You get 4 Warnings from the referee. This move does 2 Back damage and an additional 3 Back damage for each Strike Momentum you have.

name: Choke In The Corner
description: Play only in the ring. You get 2 Warnings. Your opponent loses 2 Attitude. If your opponent has at least 2 Knowledge, he loses 1.

name: Clip
description: Your opponent is put on the mat and is Grounded.

name: DDT
description: You may choose to lose 2 Attitude. If you do, this move does +6 damage.

name: Double Underhook Suplex
description: Your opponent's next 4 pages from playbook are ditched.

name: Flip-Over Cover
description: Counters head down and victim below moves. If you have Knowledge, draw a page. You attempt to pin your opponent. If the pin fails you remain in control.

name: Flying Forearm
description: Play only in the ring. Gain +2 Attitude. Your opponent is put on the mat.

name: Garbage Can Lid Shot
description: Play only in a Hardcore match. Your opponent is put on the mat and loses 1 Technical. If he then has 0 Technical, you draw a page. This move does +4 damage if any Superstar connected with "Garbage Can Shot" this match.

name: Garbage Can Shot
description: Play only in a Hardcore match. Countered by Mafia Kick. Your opponent is put on the mat and loses 1 Knowledge. If he then has 0 Knowledge, you draw a page.

name: Gut Buster
description: Strike Combo: +4 damage. (This move does +4 damage if you connected with a Strike move last turn.)

name: Jawbreaker
description: Counters victim below moves. If this move connects as a counter, and you have more Agility than your opponent has Strength, your opponent ditches two pages from hand.

name: Knee Breaker
description: If your opponent has 7 leg damage, you draw "Back Heel Trip" from your playbook. Then, your opponent takes 6 leg damage.

name: Low Blow Kick
description: You receive 3 Warnings from the referee. Your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

name: Neckbreaker
description: If your opponent has at least 2 Strength, he loses 1.

name: Punch the Chair
description: Big Superstars Trademark Play only if Steel Folding Chair is in play. Counters "Chair Shot" and "Running Chair Shot". When used as a counter, this move can't be countered and does +4 damage.

name: Rake On The Ropes
description: Play only in the ring. Choose a move type (other than defensive). A random move in your opponent's hand that matches that move type is buried. You get 1 Warning.

name: Russian Leg Sweep
description: Counters behind opponent and back to foe moves. Your opponent's next page is ditched.

name: Samoan Drop
description: Counters mad rush moves.

name: Side Back Breaker
description: Counters in close moves. This move does 3 Back damage.

name: Side Suplex
description: Play only if you have at least as much Strength as your opponent. One of your opponent's Gameplans (from in hand or in play, randomly chosen) are ditched.

name: Sunset Flip
description: Counters head down moves. Countered by standing above moves. You are put on the mat when you play this. Your opponent is put on the mat and you attempt a pin. If the pin fails, you remain in control and draw a page.

name: Suplex Onto The Ropes
description: Willpower 2 Can't be played against Big Superstars. Strike Combo: This move does +2 damage and you get +2 Attitude.

name: Suplex To The Floor
description: Play this move only if both you and your opponent are in the ring. Both you and your opponent are moved to Ringside.

name: Swinging Neckbreaker
description: Counters head down moves. Choose one: Your Technical Momentum or your opponent's Knowledge Momentum. Your opponent ditches pages from playbook equal to the amount of your choice (up to 7).

name: Vertical Suplex
description: Counters in close moves. Countered by Up and Over.

name: Bear Hug
description: Counters in close and mad rush moves, is countered by Ear Clap. This move does 4 Back damage per turn.

name: Belly-to-Belly Suplex
description: Counters in close and mad rush moves.

name: Belly-to-Belly To Ringside
description: Play only in the ring. Your opponent is moved to Ringside and has a 20% chance of being stunned until the end of next turn.

name: Clothesline In The Corner
description: Play only in the ring. Your opponent loses 1 Attitude.

name: Clothesline Over The Ropes
description: Play this move only if both you and your opponent are in the ring. Countered by Back Body Drop To Ringside. This move does up to +7 damage. Your opponent is moved to Ringside.

name: Corner Barrage
description: Play this move only if you have hit two moves in a row and only in the ring. If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

name: Corner Charge
description: Play only if you are Rikishi or if you have any Agility, and only in the ring. You may choose to lose 2 Attitude when this move connects. If you do, this move does +6 damage.

name: Corner Squash
description: Play only in the ring. Counters behind opponent moves. Your opponent takes 1 back damage, +2 back damage for each Strength you have.

name: Crucifix Roll-Up
description: Counters arm extended and mad rush moves. You draw a page, your opponent is put on the mat and you attempt a pin. If the pin fails you remain in control.

name: Double Back Breaker
description: Brock Lesnar Trademark Your opponent takes up to 10 back damage. If they have a Status, they take an additional 10 back damage.

name: Dragon Screw Leg Whip
description: Counters leg extended moves. This move does 1 Leg damage for each Technical you have. If used as a counter, draw a page when this move connects.

name: Fisherman's Suplex
description: Your opponent is pinned. If the pin does not work you stay in Control.

name: Flying Wheel Kick
description: Counters mad rush moves. Unless your opponent has less than 4 pages in hand, your opponent ditches 2 random pages. This move does up to +3 damage.

name: Gut Wrench Suplex
description: Your opponent's next page in playbook is ditched.

name: High Knee
description: Only Triple H may play High Knee. Counters mad rush moves. Cannot be countered by Strength moves. Your opponent ditches pages from his playbook equal to your Attitude Momentum, and is put on the mat.

name: Kitchen Sink Shot
description: Your opponent is Insulted.

name: Ladder Shot
description: Play only if a Ladder is in play. Countered by Duck. Counters Climb The Ladder. You get 5 Warnings and a +5% climb chance. If your opponent is Busted Wide Open or Staggered, he is stunned until the end of next turn.

name: Lariat
description: Counters hit or miss and mad rush moves. When you play this move, name a move type (not Defensive). If this connects, your opponent buries a move of the chosen move type and is put on the mat.

name: Leaping Front Kick
description: Strike Combo: This move does +3 damage. Leg Extended Combo: Gain +2 Attitude. (If you just hit with a leg extended move that is Strike, you get both Combos.)

name: Lift Into Post
description: Play this move only if both you and your opponent are at Ringside. Your opponent is put on the mat, ditches a random page and is Stunned until the end of the next turn.

name: Low Blow Uppercut
description: Counters leg extended and victim below moves. You get 4 Warnings from the Referee. This move does up to +7 damage. There is a 50% chance your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn. (Heel page.)

name: Release German Suplex
description: Original Technical page.

name: Running Clothesline
description: Counters mad rush moves. Choose a page in hand. If this move connects that page is ditched, you get Crowd Support, your opponent ditches a random page from hand and is put on the mat.

name: Running Headbutt
description: Spike Dudley Trademark Choose a Method. Your opponent ditches all moves of that Method and draws a page.

name: Set Up A Table
description: Play only if your opponent is stunned or if you have 10 Momentum. A Table is put into play. This move provides no Momentum.

name: Shoulder Breaker
description: Your opponent is put on the mat. This move does Arm damage equal to your Technical.

name: Sidewalk Slam
description: Counters mad rush moves.

name: Snap Suplex
description: Counters head down and in close moves. This move does +1 damage for each Attitude you have, up to +5.

name: Spine Buster
description: Counters mad rush moves. This move does 3 Back damage.

name: Straight Jacket Takedown
description: Five random pages from your playbook are revealed. Choose one; it is pushed and the others stay where they were.

name: Straight Right Hand
description: Your opponent is Staggered.

name: Strong Clothesline
description: Big Superstars Trademark Counters mad rush moves. Your opponent is put on the mat. If you played Irish Whip with this move, you draw a page. (Counts as "Clothesline.")

name: Throw Over The Ropes
description: Play only in the ring. Your opponent is sent to ringside. Unless already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

name: Whip Into Corner Post
description: If your opponent has less than 8 Arm damage, this move does 4 Arm damage. Otherwise, there is a 40% chance that this move stuns your opponent until the end of the next turn.

name: Back Breaker
description: This move does 5 back damage.

name: Barbed-Wire 2x4 Shot
description: This move can't be countered. Your opponent is Busted Wide Open. You lose control at the end of the turn.

name: Brainbuster Suplex
description: If your opponent has 7 Head damage or more, this move does +5 damage.

name: Bulldog
description: The next four pages from your opponent's playbook are ditched.

name: Choke Lift
description: Your opponent can't submit to this move. Each turn this hold is applied you get 1 Warning and your opponent takes damage equal to your Strength.

name: Cow Bell Shot
description: Bradshaw Trademark Counters mad rush moves. You get 5 Warnings (except the first time you connect with this move). Your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

name: Dragon Sleeper
description: Your opponent takes 6 Head damage per turn.

name: Drop Onto The Barricade
description: Play only at Ringside. Your opponent is put on the mat and you draw Set Up A Table or Spanish Announce Table from your playbook (randomly chosen if you have both). (Counts as "Snake Eyes")

name: Fallaway Slam
description: This move can only be used as a counter if you have 4 Strength, and only counters hit or miss moves that aren't Drop moves. This move does +1 damage for each Agility your opponent has.

name: Flip Flop and Fly
description: Bubba Ray Dudley Trademark Your opponent is put on the mat. If he has a Status, you draw a page. Otherwise, he is Staggered.

name: Gargoyle Suplex
description: Can only be played by Tazz. Counters mad rush moves. Two random pages in your opponent's hand are moved to your hand. Your opponent then draws a page.

name: Leaping Side Kick
description: Booker T Trademark Your opponent is put on the mat. If you played a Damage special with this move and it connects, you draw two random Drop moves. Otherwise, this does up to +4 damage.

name: Northern Lights Suplex
description: Counters Power Bomb and Piledriver. If this move connects you attempt to pin your opponent. If the pin fails you get a +7% pin chance bonus for the rest of the match.

name: Overhead Belly-to-Belly Suplex
description: Counters mad rush moves. Your opponent loses 1 Agility. If you have 3 Technical you gain +1 Attitude. (Counts as "Belly-to-Belly Suplex.")

name: Piledriver
description: Your opponent takes 10 Head damage.

name: Power Slam
description: Counters high risk and mad rush moves. This move does an additional +1 damage for each Strength you have (up to +5.) If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

name: Press Slam
description: Counters mad rush moves.

name: Pump Handle Slam
description: Test Trademark Counters head down and back to foe moves. If your opponent isn't stunned and has connected with less Impact moves than you, he is stunned until the end of next turn.

name: Punches In The Corner
description: Play only in the ring and only if you have hit two moves in a row. Countered by Shove. This move does 6 damage each turn it is applied, and can only be applied for 3 turns.

name: Running Neckbreaker
description: Counters head down moves. Choose a page in hand. If this move connects that page is ditched, you get Crowd Support and your opponent is put on the mat.

name: Running Powerslam
description: Can't be played against Big Superstars. If you have more pages in hand than your opponent, this move does +4 damage. (Counts as Power Slam.)

name: Short Arm Clothesline
description: Counters arm extended moves. Your opponent is put on the mat. Your opponent loses 1 Knowledge.

name: Shoulder To Midsection
description: Counters in close moves. If this move connects and wasn't used as a counter, a random victim below move is drawn from your playbook.

name: Slam Into Announce Table
description: Play only at Ringside. All of your opponent's Gameplan Specials that are in play are ditched.

name: Spear
description: Edge Trademark Counters mad rush moves. If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of next turn and you draw "Catch Him Stunned" from your playbook.

name: Suplex From The Ladder
description: Play only if a Ladder is in play. Counters Climb The Ladder. You get 5 Warnings and a +5% climb chance. If used as a counter without a Damage special, this move can't be countered.

name: Thrust Uppercut
description: Counters head down moves. If this move connects and wasn't used as a counter, either Clothesline, Strong Clothesline or Drop Kick To The Floor (randomly chosen) is drawn from your playbook.

name: Torito
description: Rey Mysterio Trademark The pages in your hand and your opponent's hand are shuffled into their owner's playbooks. Then, both draw replacement pages (one per page buried).

name: Tornado DDT
description: Play only if you have hit two moves in a row. Your opponent's next 2 pages from playbook and 1 random page from hand are ditched. Your opponent takes 3 Head damage.

name: Trap In The Corner
description: Play only if a Ladder is in play and you and your opponent are in the ring. If this move connects, you get 5 Warnings and your opponent is Trapped. (If your next move is a Strike move or Drop Kick it can't be countered.)

name: Whip Into Steel Steps
description: Play this move only when both you and your opponent are at Ringside. Your opponent ditches two random pages and is put on the mat. You gain +1 Attitude.

name: Body Vice
description: Brock Lesnar Trademark Your opponent takes 5 damage and 1 back damage each turn this is applied. If he is Busted Wide Open, they take 11 damage and 1 back damage instead.

name: Dragon Suplex
description: Counters back to foe moves. After this move connects, you pin your opponent. If the pin does not work, you stay in control.

name: Face Plant
description: Edge Trademark If you have 5 Attitude, draw two pages.

name: Full Nelson Slam
description: Original Strength page.

name: German Suplex
description: Counters back to foe moves. Your opponent loses 1 additional Momentum and is pinned. If the pin does not work you stay in Control.

name: Golden Globes
description: Goldust Trademark Play only in the ring and only if you have hit two moves in a row. Your opponent is Grounded and Insulted.

name: Lita's Twist of Fate
description: Lita Trademark Choose a Face page in your playbook. You draw that page from your playbook. (You can't play this page if you don't have any in your playbook.)

name: Low Blow Mule Kick
description: Counters behind opponent moves. Your opponent is put on the mat and stunned next turn. You receive 4 Warnings. When used as a counter, there is a 90% chance that you receive only 1 Warning.

name: One Arm Bulldog
description: Chris Jericho Trademark Play only in the ring. A random high risk move is drawn from your playbook.

name: Power Bomb
description: Cruiserweight Trademark Play only against a Cruiserweight. Can't be played by a Diva. Technical Combo: This move does +7 damage. Willpower 2

name: Ring Bell Shot
description: Play only if your opponent is stunned or at ringside, and only once per match. You get 5 Warnings and your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn and is Busted Wide Open.

name: Shoulder Thrusts In The Corner
description: Brock Lesnar Trademark Play only in the ring and only if you hit with a move last turn. Choose one of these Statuses: Grounded, Frustrated, or Staggered. Your opponent gets that Status.

name: Sleeper
description: Counters mad rush moves. Countered by Back Suplex. This move does 2 head damage per turn. Each turn, if your opponent has 0 Attitude, a random move from his hand is ditched. Otherwise, he loses 1 Attitude.

name: Snake Eyes
description: Your opponent ditches 2 random pages.

name: Throw Into The Cage
description: Play only in a Cage Match, and only if you have at least as much Strength as your opponent. If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn. (Counts as "Throw Over The Ropes.")

name: Tiger Suplex
description: This move pins your opponent with +1% pin chance for each Head damage your opponent has.

name: Edge-o-matic
description: Edge Trademark Counters back to foe moves. Your opponent can't play Specials (except Once Too Often) until this move is countered. You get a +7% pin chance for the rest of the match.

name: Electric Chair
description: Counters back to foe moves. You take 4 damage and gain +2 Attitude. Technical Combo: Your opponent's next five pages in playbook are ditched.

name: Lead Pipe Shot
description: Your opponent is put on the mat and is Busted Wide Open. You get 7 Warnings and Lead Pipe is ditched from play.

name: Power Bomb From Ladder
description: Counters Climb The Ladder. Play only if a Ladder is in play. You get 5 Warnings and a +5% climb chance. If used as a counter, this move can't be countered.

name: Release Spine Buster
description: Counters mad rush moves. If your opponent has 7 Back damage, he ditches all Strength moves in hand. (Counts as "Spine Buster".)

name: Reverse DDT
description: Counters in close moves. Can only be used as a counter if you have Agility. The next four pages from your opponent's playbook are ditched.

name: Running Ladder Shot
description: This move requires a Ladder in play. Counters Climb The Ladder. You get 5 Warnings and a +5% climb chance. Your opponent is put on the mat and unless he has 2 Agility, he is Busted Wide Open.

name: Wraparound Neckbreaker
description: William Regal Trademark Counters arm extended moves. Choose one: This move does 5 Arm and 5 Head damage, or you draw a random Special from your playbook.

name: Corner Post Rack
description: This move can't counter any moves, and can only be countered by Punch, Shove and Eye Rake. Can't be played against Big Superstars. Each turn this move gives you 3 Warnings and your opponent 5 Back damage.

name: Double Powerbomb
description: This may only be played by Chris Jericho. Counters head down moves. This move does +2 damage for each type of Momentum you have.

name: Guitar Shot
description: Play only if no one has played this move yet this match, and only in a Hardcore match. Your opponent is stunned for the next two turns.

name: Spinning Powerslam
description: Brock Lesnar Trademark This move does +1 damage for each Attitude you have (up to +5).

name: T-Bone Suplex
description: Only Tazz may play T-Bone Suplex. Counters leg extended and mad rush moves. All opponent's pages in hand that are not Specials are buried. That player then draws three pages.

name: The Side Effect
description: Matt Hardy Trademark Big Superstars can Autocounter this move for -3 pages, but take +8 damage from this move. You draw a page.

name: Facebuster
description: Only Triple H may play Facebuster. Your opponent ditches pages from his playbook equal to the amount of Technical and Strength Momentum you have.

name: Rolling German Suplex
description: Chris Benoit Trademark Counters back to foe moves. This move does +1 to +8 damage and your opponent ditches 1 to 3 random pages.

name: Spinning Powerbomb
description: Brock Lesnar Trademark Your opponent is stunned (if not already stunned), and Grounded.

name: Crucifix Powerbomb
description: Play only if you haven't connected with this move this match. Countered by Up and Over. If you have 4 Strength or more, your opponent's next 17 pages from playbook are ditched.

name: Stratusfaction
description: Trish Stratus Finisher Counters back to foe and in close moves. Your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn (unless already stunned). (Counts as "Bulldog".)

name: X-Factor
description: Only X-Pac may play X-Factor. Counters head down moves. This move does up to +9 damage. If your opponent is not stunned, he is stunned until the end of the next turn.

name: Bubba Bomb
description: Bubba Ray Dudley Finisher Counters arm extended moves. This move does +1 damage (up to +12) for each Takedown you have connected with. When used as a counter when not in control, this move can't be countered.

name: Choke Slam To Hell
description: Only Kane may play Choke Slam To Hell. Counters mad rush and in close moves. If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn. (Counts as "Chokeslam".)

name: F5
description: Brock Lesnar Finisher This move does +5 damage for each of these Statuses your opponent received this match: Grounded, Busted Wide Open, Frustrated, and Staggered.

name: Flying Chair Shot
description: Only Shane McMahon may play Flying Chair Shot. When you play this move you ditch your hand and Steel Folding Chair is put into play. You get 10 Warnings from the Referee. This move may not be countered.

name: The Guillotine
description: Only Steve Blackman may play The Guillotine. For each Momentum your opponent has, this move does +1 damage. Unless already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

name: Tombstone Piledriver
description: Kane Finisher Counters Tombstone Piledriver. This move does +1 damage for each Strength and Strike Momentum you have.

name: Unprettier
description: Christian Finisher This move does +2 damage for each momentum type your opponent has. If not already stunned, this move stuns your opponent until the end of the next turn.

name: Angle Slam
description: Kurt Angle Finisher Counters arm extended, in close, and back to foe moves. This move does +5 damage for each "Three I's" Special you have in play.

name: Clothesline From Hell
description: Bradshaw Finisher Your opponent is put on the mat. This move does +4 damage for each pair of Strength and Strike you have (up to +20).
